subject: Day 25: 1-month visit window opens; bring the feeding log
bodyText:
Today's focus
Day 25. The 1-month well visit window opens this week (day 28-35). If today is the visit, bring the feeding log, the diaper-output notes, and a written question list — the time goes fast.

Action items
- Bring the feeding log, diaper-output notes, and written questions to the 1-month visit. AAP HealthyChildren first-month overview: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/Pages/default.aspx
- Ask the pediatrician about jaundice resolution, weight trajectory, and the 2-month vaccine schedule. AAP on immunizations: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/immunizations/aap-policy-on-immunizations/
- Confirm Anoushka's 6-week postpartum OB visit is scheduled for around day 42. ACOG on the postpartum period: https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/postpartum-pain-management
- Continue daycare tours and waitlist deposits if returning to work in 9-13 weeks. ChildCare.gov directory: https://www.childcare.gov/

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Cradle cap on the scalp; a blocked tear duct (continuous tearing in one eye, no redness); brief head lifts during tummy time.
- [low concern] Early cooing and the first reflex-versus-social smiles during alert windows.
- [monitor] Crying trending past three hours a day on more than three days a week — the colic pattern, which peaks at six to eight weeks.
- [call within 24h] Forceful projectile vomiting with weight loss, or fewer than six wet diapers in 24 hours.
- [call now] Rectal temperature at or above 100.4F (38.0C). Lethargy, refusing all feeds, blue or grey color, breathing faster than 60 per minute at rest, persistent grunting, projectile or bilious-green vomiting. Call 911 for blue lips or unresponsiveness!

Enrichment opportunities
- Read aloud 15 minutes during the morning wake window; high-contrast board books (Tana Hoban's Black on White) hold a one-month-old's attention best. Reach Out and Read evidence base: https://reachoutandread.org/
- Set up a black-white-red high-contrast mobile 8-12 inches above the play mat; the visual cortex still prefers high contrast at this age. AAP HealthyChildren on infant senses: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/Pages/default.aspx
- Tummy time 15-20 minutes a day across short post-feed bouts; use a chest incline if floor time fatigues him. AAP HealthyChildren on tummy time: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/sleep/Pages/Back-to-Sleep-Tummy-to-Play.aspx
- Take a 20-30 minute stroller walk in daylight; morning light helps entrain his circadian rhythm. AAP HealthyChildren on vitamin D and sunlight: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/healthy-living/nutrition/Pages/Vitamin-D-On-the-Double.aspx

Upcoming
- Day 28-35: 1-month well visit window.
- Day 35-42: peak-crying curve.
- Day 42: maternal 6-week postpartum visit.
- Day 56-70: 2-month well visit; first round of vaccines.
